newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks expected to head higher in early trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks expected to head higher in early trade.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to make gains when they start inaugural day trading on Monday but volume will be slim as bonds will not be in play.
The bond market is closed for Martin Luther King Jr Day, a federal holiday. The stock market will remain open.

"This is a holiday so it will be quiet relative to last week," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. "We will be steady at the open and then we have to see whether we keep the forward momentum."
The Dow closed above 6800 for the first time Friday.
